description: The plot illustrates how BLEU varies with Average Lagging (AL) for multiple methods, showing several lines on the same axes. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” on a linear scale, spanning roughly from −1 to 7 with labeled ticks at 0, 2, 4, and 6. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” on a linear scale, ranging from 12 to 28 with evenly spaced tick labels every 2 units. One line is a light purple dashed line with circular markers labeled “Consistency-CE,” increasing from about 13 at AL ≈ −0.5 to about 26.4 at AL ≈ 7, with intermediate points near 19.8 (AL ≈ 1), 22.4 (AL ≈ 4), and 24.8 (AL ≈ 6). A second line is a darker purple dashed line with square markers labeled “Inconsistency-CE,” starting near 20.0 at AL ≈ 1 and rising to about 27.0 at AL ≈ 7, passing through approximately 22.6 (AL ≈ 2), 25.0 (AL ≈ 4), and 26.2 (AL ≈ 6). A third line is a blue dashed line with square markers labeled “Inconsistency-CE-MP,” beginning around 19.8 at AL ≈ 1 and increasing to about 27.2 at AL ≈ 7, with points near 22.7 (AL ≈ 2), 25.0 (AL ≈ 4), and 26.0 (AL ≈ 6). A fourth line is a red solid line with star markers (label text not visible in the legend), rising from about 22.6 at AL ≈ −0.5 to about 27.8 at AL ≈ 7, with intermediate values around 24.2 (AL ≈ 1.5), 25.9 (AL ≈ 3.5), and 26.8 (AL ≈ 6).
